articleTitle: Application of Laser Detector in Intelligent Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The 21st century is a brand new century and a century of informationization. We have ushered in a new informationization era. The advent of this era is not just the passage of time, it also represents the high-quality and rapid development of modern science and technology. progress. At present, with the change of social contradictions in our country, people have higher requirements for the quality of life. There have been qualitative changes in the usual food and clothing consumption and quality of life. For example, in the traffic environment, people advocate intelligence and pursue safer travel. In order to meet people's needs, my country has invested a lot in the development of science and technology. Now, my country has built an intelligent transportation system, and our country is also looking for more advanced technologies to improve this system. The application of lidar detection to the transportation system is the current development direction of our transportation system. This paper mainly introduces the basic principles and related technologies of lidar detection, and briefly introduces the types of laser detectors and their applications in intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: Mixture Loss Function-based Classification Network for Few-shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Data augmentation technology can effectively solve the problem of few-shot image classification, but many approaches based on data augmentation generated sample have poor discriminability, which negatively affects the classifier and classification accuracy needs to be improved. In this regard, based on the TFFCN, a mixture loss function-based classification network for few-shot learning (MLFCN) is proposed. First of all, for the prototype tensor features with a simple mean representation, ignoring the different contributions of the sample features of support set for per class to the class prototype tensor features, so that the generated prototype tensor features can not well represent sample features of per class, affecting the discriminability of the generated samples. Introduce the improved adaptively spatial feature fusion module, it uses the convolution, considers the support set of different sample features on the prototype tensor, adaptively assign weights, then weighted and summed to obtain a more representative prototype tensor feature; secondly, aiming at the blurred classification boundary of similar categories in the generated sample features, a mixture loss function is proposed. The loss function is to add the inter-class mean squared error term to the mean square error loss, and stretches the inter-class distance of the generated tensor feature, so that the classification boundary is clearer, so as to train a better classifier. Experimental results show that the improved adaptively spatial feature fusion and the mixing loss function can augment the discriminability of the generated tensor features and further improve the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Control of Underwater Robots Based on Neural Network Backstepping Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In terms of the trajectory tracking control of the spherical underwater vehicle, its movement is divided into the horizontal movement and the vertical movement. For the vertical movement, the motion model is built by transformation, and the trajectory tracking control law is designed by the neural network backstepping method. Simulation results and experiment results verify the effectiveness of the control law. The linear trajectory keeping method for the horizontal movement is designed according to the gyroscope approximation theory. Repeated experiments verify that the vehicle's high-speed rotation on the long axis can effectively weaken the course shift which is caused by flow interference.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Smart Snack Vending Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Smart vending machines refer to vending machines that can meet the needs of the crowd for mobility and intelligence. In order to improve development capabilities, enhance development experience, and meet the needs of more customers, an intelligent snack vending machine is designed. The design uses STM32F103C8T6 as the MCU, and simulates the process of the user completing the purchase and taking out the items through the steering gear and infrared pairing tube. When the inventory of the item is insufficient, the voice module will broadcast a reminder, and transmit it to the mobile phone through wireless communication technology. Check the status of the goods through the mobile terminal. The design is a new and practical smart vending machine.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data Mining Application of Internet of Things Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In order to scientifically deal with the problem of network extension, optimize the application performance of the Internet of Things technology and equipment, and truly meet the requirements of big data application of the Internet of Things, in the development of modern economic construction, scholars from various countries in the integration of their own research experience on the basis of data mining technology as the main topic. The integration and application of artificial intelligence technology in iot big data mining not only changes the thinking mode of traditional data mining analysis, but also grasps a variety of technical methods in practical research. Therefore, on the basis of understanding artificial intelligence technology and big data mining algorithm of Internet of Things, this paper deeply discusses how to apply artificial intelligence technology algorithm in big data mining of Internet of things. The final experimental results show that the value of F -measure can be increased by 15.01 % and 17.52% at most, while R1 can be increased by 20.32 % and 25.03 % at most.

articleTitle: Inchworm Robot Structural Design and Kinematic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The structure of a bionic robot is created using the inchworm's motion mechanism as inspiration. And the universal joint's properties are used to realize the robot's multi-motion mode functionality. The forward and inverse kinematics are examined by D-H modeling. The mechanical model of the robot is created by using ADAMS simulation software. It shows that the relative error of the model is less than 0.4% after comparison between the mathematical model and the simulation mechanical model. The results suggest the accuracy of the kinematic model and offer a new approach to kinematic modeling verification. It is demonstrated that the bionic robot with this structure can realize a variety of motion gaits through simulation and analysis of the inchworm robot, such as steering, obstacle-crossing. This design serves as a reference for bionic robot structure research.

articleTitle: Model Construction, Problems and Countermeasures of Intelligent Logistics Ecosystem Driven by Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the process of the development of the digital economy increasingly, block chain and the Internet of things, cloud computing, big data analysis, a new generation of digital technologies such as artificial intelligence fusion application drives the intelligent logistics constantly change, build a logistics business system, the logistics system of supply chain and logistics chain system as the core of ecological intelligent logistics system, but due to the block chain technology is still in its infancy, Therefore, there are some problems such as rough technology and imperfect three core systems. Countermeasures and suggestions for the development of intelligent logistics ecological system are put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Off-line Programming Technology of Robot General Spraying Based on DELMIA
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: According to the application requirements of robot spraing off-line programming, this paper analyzes the problems of commercial off-line programming software commonly used in the market, and puts forward a set of robot general spraying off-line programming and simulation system based on DELMIA platform and using CAA and VBA interface. The architecture of the general off-line programming system is introduced, and the key technologies such as spraying process information extraction, spraying trajectory planning, robot spraying attitude, simulation and post-processing are studied and analyzed. Finally, a general off-line programming software for spraying is developed and applied to a certain wing sample. The test results meet the actual needs.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Intelligent Mowing System Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Among all kinds of lawn machinery, mower is the mainstream product, because the task of mowing is large and has strong repeatability. However, due to the backward technology, the traditional lawn mower consumes a lot of human and material resources. Therefore, the United States and other western countries put forward the concept of intelligent lawn mower robot. Intelligent mower is a very complex system, which integrates a variety of functions and technologies. Therefore, the research on Intelligent mower involves many aspects. This topic focuses on path planning and obstacle detection technology. Path planning technology is to plan a path without collision with obstacles between the starting point and the target point according to the perceived working environment information and some optimization index, and complete the expected task. Obstacle detection technology helps the mower to detect small or moving obstacles when walking along the planned path through sensors, so that the mower can avoid opening obstacles in time. This paper introduces the basic knowledge of path planning, which includes traditional point-to-point path planning and whole-area coverage path planning, analyzes and compares the differences between them, and deeply studies the whole-area coverage path planning according to the working requirements of lawn mowers.

articleTitle: The Application of Industrial Automation Computer Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the innovation and development of computer application industry, the scope of industrial automation computer application industry is more and more large, the overall development model in the market, economy, resources and other factors under the influence of new changes. Under the development trend of economic globalization, in the face of increasingly fierce competition in the market environment, in order to obtain more economic benefits and social effects, we should strengthen the technological innovation and research efforts at the same time, control the social necessary labor time, improve the efficiency of practical work, which is also the inevitable choice of industrial development in the new era. In this paper, on the basis of understanding the concept of computer control technology, according to the application research of industrial automation computer control system in recent years, focus on the computer control technology in industrial automation control system application direction, combined with practical cases, determine the future development direction of computer control system.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease based on logistic regression algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Language impairment may be an important early manifestation of dementia. In this study, we propose a multi-feature fusion to distinguish MCI and AD patients. In this paper, a set of acoustic, demographic and linguistic features were selected, and after data processing, logistic regression algorithm was used to diagnose MCI and AD patients. In order to get better results, comparative experiments are also effectively conducted, including different combination methods and different group distinctions with the three most popular algorithms. Studies have shown that this method is more advantageous and the classification results are more accurate.

articleTitle: Design of telecom operators IDC resale analysis system based on Spark
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: A design based on Spark technology is proposed to solve the problem that the telecom operators' network bandwidth resources are resold. We use big data components such as Hadoop, Spark, Hive, HBase, and Zookeeper to build a domain name server logs analysis system and improve the generalized suffix automaton algorithm to match the logs of telecom operator customers with the logs for building a registration information database. Finally, we make an online log analysis platform based on Spring boot to discriminate data. Experiments show that based on Spark technology, the operator resources resale analysis system can accurately match operator telecom customer logs from massive logs. This design is of great significance to realize the operator's network bandwidth business clean, efficient, and high-quality operation with building a harmonious development network environment.

articleTitle: Research on Voice Control Technology for Home Smart Elderly Care
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: As the aging population continues to highlight, helping the elderly live easily is inseparable from the help of technology. Voice recognition system, as the core module of smart home, has an irreplaceable position. This paper conducts research on voice control technology for smart home care. Firstly, the paper analyzes the smart home system based on voice control technology, and then analyzes the dynamic time warping (DTW) voice control algorithm. In order to explore the feasibility of DTW algorithm speech recognition for smart home systems, the author designed a program through MATLAB to test isolated speech recognition and record the results. At the same time, verify its speech recognition success rate for different words. Repeat the voice test for the switch of home equipment, and count the success rate to verify the feasibility of the algorithm in the field of smart home control.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Parking Demand Based on Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: This paper discusses the contradiction between insufficient parking supply and rising parking demand, and analyzes the relevant indicators of parking demand. Based on the ARMA model, the short-term parking demand is predicted and the validity of the parking demand is verified. Predicted results can be used to make correct vehicle guidance and parking decisions.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Complex Float Matrix Multiplication Operation Based on High-level Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: The large scale floating point matrix operations are widely used in numerical analysis, image processing and signal processing. This paper studies the design and implementation of the complex floating-point matrix multiplication operations based on high level synthesis (HLS), mainly including the design and implementation of complex floating-point matrix operation architecture, the large-scale RAM model, and the random matrix verification platform. The complex-floating-point multiplication and accumulation array is designed by HLS approach, the large-scale complex floating point matrix-vector multiply operation is implemented by instancing and paralleling the arrays, and the chip development period is greatly shorted. The correctness of complex matrix operation is verified by establishing a random verification platform. The operation latency is only 22 cycles for the 32-dimension complex-floating-point matrix multiplication at a clock cycle of 800MHz, that is only 27.5ns to implement the matrix-vector multiplication operation under the pipelining processing and the circuit meets the timing requirements.

articleTitle: Design and Technical Research of the End-executive Agency of Medical Robots
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the steady development of modern science and technology, robotics has been widely used in the medical field, among which the most representative is minimally invasive surgery, with low cost, quick recovery, small trauma and other technical advantages. Combined with the application results of medical robot technology in recent years, it is shown that dynamics and kinematics are the basis for realizing end-effector control. When constructing end-effector, fixed-point motion should be carried out on the basis of kinematics simulation. Therefore, this article studies in celiac minimally invasive robot technology, for example, according to its application in the field of current medical situation, deeply discusses the overall structure of the modern medical robot end actuators and application technology, and combining the practical application cases to investigate the stability and accuracy of surgery, in order to provide effective basis for the development of modern medical technology.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Development of Conventional Bus and Subway Operation Scheduling: Take Guangzhou as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Studying on the coordinated development of conventional bus and subway dispatching, matching the departure interval and model configuration of connected bus based on subway passenger flow, can effectively reduce the waiting time for passenger. Firstly, an operational optimization model aiming at minimizing the passenger's transfer time and the total cost of bus operators is established, and the comprehensive threshold of dispatching coordination is determined. By analyzing the distribution characteristics of the passenger flow of connected bus line, the initial departure timetable of connected bus at the peak rush hour is made; Secondly, determining the initial model proposal with the full load rate as the constraint, and getting the initial dispatching coordination plan; Finally, analyzing the full load rate of the bus line. If the full load rate is too high or too low, adjusting the departure interval and model configuration to get the final bus and subway dispatching coordination plan.

articleTitle: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Strategy for UAV Autonomous Landing on a Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is increasingly becoming an important tool used for a variety of tasks. In addition, Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a popular research topic. In this paper, these two fields are combined together and we apply the reinforcement learning into the UAV field, promote the application of reinforcement learning in our real life. We design a reinforcement learning framework named ROS-RL, this framework is based on the physical simulation platform Gazebo and it can address the problem of UAV motion in continuous action space. We can connect our algorithms into this framework through ROS and train the agent to control the drone to complete some tasks. We realize the autonomous landing task of UAV using three different reinforcement learning algorithms in this framework. The experiment results show the effectiveness of algorithm in controlling UAV which flights in a simulation environment close to the real world.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Evaluation of Intelligent Expressway Road-related Project
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In recent years., the wave of intelligent transportation has spread all over the world., and its development in China is also unstoppable. Several intelligent highways have been built and operated rapidly., which has changed the existing traffic pattern. However., the intelligent highway as a new mode of transportation., its road test facilities., cloud control platform and other contents will produce a series of new road-related projects. In order to study the road-related engineering of this new intelligent highway., this paper establishes an intelligent highway road-related evaluation system by analyzing the research situation and technical means of the existing intelligent highway. By studying the weight and comprehensive safety level of different indicators in the system., an evaluation model with entropy weight method and matter element method as the core and fuzzy calculation method is formed to enrich the shortcomings of the existing road-related engineering in the intelligent highway.

articleTitle: A Recursive Descent Analysis-based Solution for Smart Contract Generation and Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In the field of supply chain, due to the involvement of multiple business entities, incomplete credit mechanism and information asymmetry have been the difficulties in supply chain that need to be solved. With the development and advancement of blockchain technology, the core technology in blockchain - smart contracts - has attracted much attention. The technology automates the execution of contracts on the blockchain in the form of code, allowing trusted transactions to take place without a third party, which are traceable and irreversible. The technology involves collaboration between different fields such as computer science and laws, but most traditional professionals lack programming skills, resulting in the current application of smart contracts can not meet cross-industry demand. This paper propose a method to generate smart contracts automatically. Users can model the contract by OWL(Web Ontology Language) and write SWRL(Semantic Web Rule Language) semantic rules to describe contract. Then use recursive descent analysis to implement a LL(1) syntax parser that recognises SWRL and generates the corresponding smart contract code based on the semantic rules of SWRL. The contract management module allows users to generate, install and manage smart contracts directly from the front-end page, which lowers the threshold for users to manage the blockchain network. We validate the usability of the contract generation and management module using the compliance inspection of RMC (ready-mixed concrete), which is based on HyperLedger Fabric. The system can generate smart contract code that corresponds logically to the quality specification.

articleTitle: Knowledge Graph Completion Technology Research
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computing, Robotics and System Sciences (ICRSS)
abstract: In recent years, knowledge graphs have been widely used in the fields of language cognition, search and recommendation, question answering systems, etc. However, with the continuous expansion of the scale of many knowledge graphs constructed by RDF, how to solve the incompleteness of knowledge graphs has become a research hotspot. knowledge graph completion technology is used to complete the missing content in the knowledge graph, mainly including entity completion and relationship completion. This paper mainly focuses on the completion problem, and sorts out completion methods based on deep representation learning. Through the analysis of the research history and latest progress of completion technology, the practical challenges and future development directions of the technology are put forward.
